description:
Change an HTML animation's site: ONE revision, linted, checked and probed. A passing save with project_id moves that project's uses; a failing one is kept but moves nothing; your next edit continues from it. Saves return a contact sheet (preview: false skips it); preview: true | {filmstrip, video, test} renders the moved element in place (dry run: unsaved page).

Send changes against your copy (server can't read your disk; no read first):
  patch: '<git diff or diff -ruN of your copy>'   any number of files
  files: [{path, edits: [{old, new, replace_all?}]}] · {path, content} · {path, patch} · {path, upload_id}
  upload_ids: [...]   from upload_file(file_names) + one curl; names are paths (media ≤200 MB too, linked relatively: media/clip.mp4)
  edits: [{op: delete|move, path, to?}]
A hunk or edit that doesn't match saves nothing (the reply shows the lines around it).

Read get_design_guide({topic: "pages"}) before writing or editing a page: the timing, scope, determinism and checking rules.
Rules: timing from cues, not voiceover words; sound: add_audio, not in-page; save to the project (library only when asked, then say where); one page per scene, split for own timing; a backdrop that runs on across clips reads window.__frame.filmTime (film seconds), not time.

Reply: rev, probe (passing|failing|pending), checks/errors ({path, line, column, code, message}), files_changed, uses_moved, uses_behind, note; detail 'full' adds hunks. dry_run: true saves nothing (a preview token). animation: 'new' creates one (name, scope).

place: {clip_index | continue_from: <element_id>, x/y/width/height?, start_time/end_time?, entry?, name?} → on that clip after a passing save: placed + element_id. No changes: the site as it is. checkpoint: '<name>' keeps a state as a version.

Refusals: stale_base, target_required ('shared'|'fork'), check_failed, breaking_unconfirmed (confirm_breaking: true). Placed elements' parameters, actions, cues: update_elements.
A canvas Mograph becomes a page first (reply: upgraded; code in index.html).

animation.description: The site to edit when there is no element; 'new' makes one (name, scope).

base_rev.description: The revision you read; a save made since is refused (stale_base).

checkpoint.description: A name for a state worth keeping (e.g. 'v1 layout'): labels the saved revision and adds it as a version to the animation's Generations history, where the user can find and restore it.

confirm_breaking.description: Move this project's uses even when the new version drops something they use (a removed or retyped parameter, action, cue or page, a new size); without it such a save moves nothing and lists `breaking`.

detail.description: 'full' adds the diff hunks and thumbnail records.

dry_run.description: Check without saving; returns a preview token for get_clip render.preview.

edits.description: Ops applied first: delete and move (replace and write work too).

element_id.description: The element whose page to edit (from the version it shows); a canvas Mograph is upgraded to a page first. Needs project_id.

files.description: Per-file changes: exactly one of edits, content, patch or upload_id each.

content.description: The whole file (new file or rewrite).

new.description: The text to put in its place.

old.description: Exact text to find (without the 'N| ' numbers); must occur once unless replace_all.

patch.description: A unified diff of this one file.

path.description: File path in the site, e.g. 'index.html'.

upload_id.description: A file sent with upload_file: text is used as the whole content (UTF-8, at most 2 MB); media (video, audio, image, font, model) is added as is (at most 200 MB).

folder.description: animation 'new' with scope 'library': folder path, e.g. 'Brand/Intros'.

patch.description: A unified diff of any number of files (git diff / diff -ruN), from the site folder.

place.description: Put the saved page on a clip in this call (after a passing save): returns element_id. Needs project_id. Without file changes: places the site as it is.

continue_from.description: An animation element of an earlier clip: carry it on into the next clip (or clip_index) from where it stopped, with its box, values and timeline.

end_time.description: Clip seconds; default the page's duration.

entry.description: Another page of the site, e.g. 'outro.html'.

name.description: The element's label in the editor (default: the site's name, or site/entry).

element_id.description: Which use to render when the save moved several (default the first).

around.description: Center the window on a cue ('cue:land') or an action clip ('action:hop', by name or id) instead of from/to. On a whole clip, a cue several animations share is 'cue:land@<element name>'.

fps.description: Frames per second instead of a count, e.g. 8 over 2 s is 17, capped at 16.

frames.description: How many frames across the window, first and last included (default 12, max 16).

from.description: Window start, element-local seconds, or clip seconds for a whole clip (default 0).

seam.description: get_clip of a whole clip only: the cut from this clip into the next, as the player shows it: this clip's last second, its transition, and the next clip's first second, in this clip's seconds; takes frames, no window. Every cut of the film at once: get_project({render: {seams: true}}).

span.description: With around: the window's length in seconds (default 2 around a cue; the clip plus 0.5 around an action).

to.description: Window end, element-local seconds, or clip seconds for a whole clip (default the end).

filmstrip.description: See motion in ONE image instead of four moments: frames spaced evenly across a window (default 12 over the whole animation), in reading order, each labelled with its element-local time, with a thin timeline under each row marking the frames, cues (lines) and action clips (bars). Read pacing, easing and whether a beat lands on its cue from it. true for the defaults, or {from, to} / {around: 'cue:<key>' | 'action:<name>', span}, with frames or fps. Replaces timestamps. On get_clip without element_id or preview it shows the whole clip, every element drawn, in clip seconds, and the timeline also ticks each element's start and end. HTML animations (pages) are drawn from their page in every render, the next clip's across a seam included; their cues and actions are the page's.

test.description: Try other settings on the one animation rendered (element_id or preview), nothing saved: parameter_values, param_tracks, actions, cues, in element-local (page) seconds. For an HTML animation the page is drawn with them; check a value or a cue before setting it with update_elements.

actions.description: Action clips to try instead of the element's: [{name, start, duration?, args?}].

param_tracks.description: Keyframes to try for animatable parameters: {key: [{t, value, interpolation?}]}.

parameter_values.description: Values to try, over the element's own (an image or video value: a URL or upload).

video.description: For people: also a short low-resolution MP4 of the same window (the filmstrip's, or the animation's first 10 s), returned as video_url, a link valid for an hour. You can't watch it: judge motion from the filmstrip.

preview.description: Omitted: the probe's contact sheet (the page at its defaults). true: render what the save produced IN PLACE -- the element it moved (a dry run: its unsaved page), cropped, at four moments. {filmstrip, video, test, element_id}: the same as a filmstrip, with a short MP4 link, or with test settings. false: no image.

probe.description: With dry_run: also render it in the probe (slower; returns its contact sheet).

project_id.description: The project: a passing save moves its uses (one undo step).

request.description: One line: what the user asked for (history).

scope.description: animation 'new' only: 'project' (default with project_id), 'element' (with for_element), or 'library' ONLY when the user asks to keep it for other videos.

target.description: When the site is used outside this project: 'shared' changes it for everyone, 'fork' copies it for this project.

upload_ids.description: Whole files sent with upload_file(file_names); each upload's name is its path.

wait_s.description: How long to wait for the probe's verdict (default the server's).

name: edit_animation
title: Edit an HTML animation
